title: Settlement happening
_note: Phase 9.5 Settlement-situation oracle: what is HAPPENING here right now, a full-sentence happening composed after the mood. Size-neutral (reads for a hamlet or a city). Situational only — never names or stats an NPC. Full sentences with terminal punctuation. All weight 1.

entries.value: A market day has drawn a crowd.
Strangers are asking questions at the inn.
A dispute between families is spilling into the open.
A caravan has just arrived, road-worn and wary.
Preparations are underway for a festival.
A funeral winds through the streets.
Armed men are quartered here, and not welcome.
A shortage has sharpened tempers.
Someone of note has gone missing.
A public accusation has set tongues wagging.
Work has halted over an unpaid debt.
A stranger is buying drinks and asking after newcomers.
A wedding — or its collapse — is the talk of the place.
Guards are turning people away at the edge of town.
A relic or treasure is rumoured to have surfaced nearby.
A public punishment is set for dawn.
Stores have been found spoiled or fouled.
A preacher or agitator draws a growing crowd.
Something is being hunted door to door.
A rich patron is quietly hiring for a job.
Two rival merchants are undercutting each other to ruin.
The well, mill, or bridge has failed.
Refugees have arrived with grim news from elsewhere.
A curfew was announced last night.
A gambling den or fighting pit is drawing hard coin.
The children keep telling the same strange story.
A shipment has gone missing on the road nearby.
An old feud has reignited.
Someone is paying well for word of newcomers.
A holy day empties the streets by dusk.
A fire has gutted a row of buildings, and the ash is still warm.
Livestock are dying of no clear cause.
A tax collector has arrived with an armed escort.
The council is meeting behind closed doors, and no one will say why.
A body was pulled from the water at dawn.
A troupe of players has set up in the square.
Broadsheets have appeared on doors overnight, and no one admits to posting them.
A sickness is spreading, and the healers cannot keep pace.
The harvest is in full swing, and every hand is needed in the fields.
A prisoner has escaped, and the gates are being searched.
Strange lights were seen over the hills, and half the town swears to it.
The river has risen, and the low streets stand in water.
A herald arrived at midday and has not yet delivered his message.
Bells have been ringing since dawn, and no two people agree why.
A great beast's carcass has been hauled into the square.
A press-gang is working the taverns for recruits.
